title: Gluten-Free Tom Kha Chicken Coconut Soup
summary: A fragrant Thai-inspired coconut chicken soup with ginger, lime, chilli and coriander standing in for harder-to-source galangal and lemongrass. It is creamy, tangy and gently spicy, ideal for a quick warming dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, thinly sliced

steps: Put the chicken stock, coconut milk, sliced ginger, crushed garlic and chilli into a large saucepan. Bring just to a simmer over medium heat, stirring so the coconut milk does not catch.
Add the sliced chicken thighs and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes, until the chicken is opaque and cooked through with no pink in the centre.
Add the mushrooms and cherry tomatoes. Simmer for another 5 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and the tomatoes have softened but still hold their shape.
Stir in the lime juice, tamari, brown sugar and salt. Taste and adjust with a little more lime juice for sharpness or salt if needed.
Remove the large garlic pieces if desired, then ladle the soup into bowls and finish with chopped coriander. Serve hot.
